written_before: any number of this experiment was read; committed before the first fit

base.predictor: v10, fold side = exp-036 arm 2 (refit-bulk at the eight mask airports, v7 at EDDF and EHAM)

inherited_from_q03_unchanged.pair_rule: fixed disjoint within-cell pairs, sorted on (cell, MVT_ID_mvt), pair 1-2, 3-4, ...
inherited_from_q03_unchanged.amplitude_cross_month: for fold f, sum over the OTHER TWO folds of r*d0 divided by the sum of d0^2, where d0 is that fold's day-block cross-fitted zero-sum update

step1_density_check.note: 600 is Q03's grid; 300 and 1200 are the fixed alternates the queue names. The ridge, the eligibility, the four-row minimum, the day blocks, alpha and the pair rule are unchanged on every grid.
step1_density_check.matched_subset_rule: within each grid, order the eligible rows by (cell code, MVT_ID_mvt); every cell with at least four eligible rows contributes exactly its FIRST FOUR rows in that order, hence exactly two disjoint pairs. Label-free and deterministic. Only the evaluation subset is matched; the ridge is unchanged.

stratum_traffic_rate.definition: the number of ELIGIBLE departures at the same airport whose take-off clock is within +/- 300 s of this row's take-off clock, the row included. A fixed physical window, identical on all three grids.

step1_density_check.readout: the pair reduction (s^2, cross-month amplitude) in the two-way table cell-rows x traffic-rate, on each grid, plus the all-row board gain of the full zero-sum arm on each grid.
step1_density_check.verdict_rule: DENSITY if the ordering by traffic rate survives conditioning on cell rows and the ordering by cell rows does not survive conditioning on traffic rate; MECHANISM if the reverse; MIXED if both survive. Stated before any number was read.

step2_learner.objective: min sum (r_c,i - d_i)^2 with d = h - mean_cell(h) and r_c the within-cell-centred v10 residual; for LightGBM implemented as a custom objective with grad_i = (h_i - mean_cell(h)_i) - r_c,i and hess_i = 1

cross_fitting.dayblock: Q03's: five contiguous day blocks inside the month, fit on four, score the fifth
cross_fitting.xmonth: fit on the OTHER TWO folds' months pooled, score the third; categorical levels frozen on the fitting months

arms.ridge: the Q03 reference, alpha 100, 202 row-only features

lgb_small.note: the capacity match: 256 leaves against the ridge's ~202 effective parameters; the budget the queue names for Q04

lgb_wide.note: 6,400 leaves, about 30x the ridge; declared only to answer whether the capacity-matched budget bound

arms.lgb_shipped: lgb_small's budget on the 202 row-only features PLUS the 89 numeric columns of the shipped block artifacts/exp-018-fresh/cache/<month>.parquet (exp-018-fresh features.py + window_features.py); 'with the shipped feature block' is read as ADDING it, so the arm nests lgb_small and the contrast is what the trees can take from the shipped block
arms.lgb_shipped_wide: lgb_wide's budget on the same 291 columns

step2_learner.pricing: all-row and clean paired gain against v10 at the cross-month amplitude, day-clustered bootstrap intervals (2000 draws, seed 39) plus 1/2/3-day moving blocks drawn inside each fold, the Q03 section-3 pair diagnostic, and the two algebraic checks (max abs cell sum of d at 1e-8 relative; full delta-SSE equals within-cell delta-SSE at 1e-8 relative)

step3_serving.arm_selection_rule: serve the arm with the largest ALL-ROW xmonth board gain among the arms whose three fold intervals are all clear of zero; ties go to the simpler arm (ridge before lgb_small before lgb_wide before the shipped arms). If no arm clears, ship the ridge (the assignment's repair) and say what the trees could not use.
step3_serving.served_amplitude: the POOLED cross-month amplitude over the three folds: sum over all three folds of r*d0 divided by the sum of d0^2, with d0 the served arm's day-block cross-fitted update. One number, computed on the fold side, stated in RESULTS before the candidate file is written, never revised on a board reading (score-feedback rule).
step3_serving.fit: h fitted on the three 2025 months whose v10 residual exists (2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-12) pooled, same within-cell centring, categorical levels frozen on those three months
step3_serving.cells: the ranking months' cells are formed from the ranking file's own rows: airport x UTC 10-minute bin x serving regime, per ranking month
step3_serving.masks: d is added AFTER v10's serving masks, so the 388 ranking noac rows and the 38,182 EHAM rows are bit-identical to v10, and EDDF's rows are unchanged by eligibility
step3_serving.gate: all-row paired fold gain over v10 on the xmonth estimator with every fold interval clear of zero at the served amplitude
step3_serving.outputs: submissions/candidates/exp-044-zerosum.parquet in template order, finite, min >= 60, with the changed-row count and the SHA-256 in RESULTS.md

step4_census: the eligible ranking rows, their cells, the share of eligible rows in cells under four rows, and the RMS of the served update by airport and by ranking month, against the fold-side RMS. A served RMS differing from the fold side by more than a third is a finding explained before any upload.
